treatment_chemistry: branched polyethylenimine (BPEI) / ammonium polyphosphate (APP) layer-by-layer coating
treatment_method: alternating BPEI (0.5 wt%, pH 10) and APP (0.5 wt%, pH 4) dip/rinse/dry cycles; no alkali pretreatment for this primary series
evidence: Open-access full article. Table 1 gives add-on and LOI for the primary PET/PET-1/PET-5/PET-10/PET-20 LBL series; Tables 3–4 give TGA for the same named untreated/LBL-treated series in N2 and air. TGA: room temperature to 650 °C at 10 °C/min.
source_title: Layer-by-layer assembly flame-retardant and anti-dripping treatment of polyethylene terephthalate fabrics
journal: Journal of Engineered Fibers and Fabrics
limitations: The paper separately studies an alkali-pretreated LBL series in Table 2 using the same PET-1/PET-5/... labels. The TGA section refers to the primary untreated/LBL-assembled series and does not report a separate alkali-pretreated TGA dataset; rows here are therefore mapped to the non-alkali primary series and retain its Table 1 add-ons.
